scripts.build: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm build:backend && pnpm --filter @sysu-welcome/frontend build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm build:contracts && tsc -p packages/contracts/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p backend/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.verify:g1: node --check scripts/dev.mjs && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.verify:g2: node --check scripts/dev.mjs && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build
scripts.test:e2e: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm build:backend && pnpm typecheck:e2e && playwright test --project=chromium-ci
scripts.test:e2e:windows: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm build:backend && pnpm typecheck:e2e && playwright test --project=chrome --project=msedge
scripts.test:e2e:all: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm build:backend && pnpm typecheck:e2e && playwright test --project=chromium-ci --project=chrome --project=msedge
scripts.test:load: pnpm build:contracts && pnpm build:backend && pnpm typecheck:load && tsx tests/load/run-g4-load.ts
scripts.verify:g3: pnpm verify:g2 && pnpm typecheck:e2e && playwright test --project=chromium-ci --project=chrome --project=msedge
scripts.verify:g4: pnpm verify:g3 && pnpm typecheck:load && tsx tests/load/run-g4-load.ts
